description: This Java source file defines the Spring MVC controller 'StoreLandingController' responsible for managing store landing page content within an admin web interface. It handles displaying and saving landing page data, interacting with content and store services, and preparing data for views.

classes.name: StoreLandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing store landing page content, including displaying current content and saving updates.

methods.name: displayStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store landing page management interface, populating the model with existing content descriptions per language.

methods.name: saveStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated store landing page content, updating or creating 'Content' and associated descriptions.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the active menu items in the model for rendering the admin interface.
